_comment: Baseline of currently-known unresolved tool-pointer instruments, keyed by instrument name. sc_pointer_validation.ts treats any unresolved pointer whose instrument is in this list as QUARANTINED (pre-existing, tracked); any unresolved pointer NOT in this list is a genuinely NEW regression and fails CI. RATCHET AT ZERO since 2026-07-30 (SAMĀPTI lane A2): the list is EMPTY, so ANY unresolved pointer anywhere in platform-mcp/src or platform/src/lib/retrieval fails CI. Do not re-add an entry to make a red build green — fix the pointer, or file a register row and record here WHY the pointer cannot be fixed yet. The SC-pointer:baseline-freshness check now FAILS on any entry here that no longer reproduces against the live tree, so an entry cannot outlive its defect (this replaces the never-implemented 'quarantine with an expiry date' idea with a structural expiry: the entry expires when the defect stops reproducing).
_history: The six entries this file carried from 2026-07-10 to 2026-07-30 are all now FIXED in production and were therefore removed, not migrated: bodha_bundle_get (SC-17 — the tool is registered at platform-mcp/src/tools/retrieval/holistic_bundle.ts:135); get_dignity, get_avasthas, get_divisionals, query_signals (SC-18 — remapped to ganita_condition_get / ganita_chart_facts_get / get_signals in registry_bridge.ts, register_d9_judgment.ts, register_d10_pact.ts, each fix site carrying an inline 'SC-18: was ...' note); get_strength (the never-filed NEW-P1, same SC-18 class — remapped to ganita_strength_get at registry_bridge.ts:3898); query_classical_texts (the never-filed NEW-P2, now filed as SC-23 — intended target verified as ref_rules_search, live at register_d9_judgment.ts:1146 per RC-04). The four remaining occurrences on 2026-07-30 were all TEST FIXTURES modelling the old, non-existent tool names; they were repointed at the live tools production actually emits.
